preorderTime.q: How long does a pre-order take?
preorderTime.a: Usually about {{weeks}} weeks. Pre-orders get {{percent}}% off, and you pay when you receive the item. We'll contact you as soon as it arrives in Armenia.

installation.a: Yes — items marked "Free installation" are installed for free. For other items we'll advise you or refer you to a trusted specialist (for example, the LED logo is connected by an auto electrician in about 15–30 minutes).

fit.q: How do I know it fits my car / year?
fit.a: Send us your car model and year (e.g. S07 2025 or 2026, EV or hybrid). We'll check and suggest the right version before you order.

deliveryPayment.a: Delivery within Arabkir district is free. Elsewhere in Yerevan delivery is free for orders from {{freeFrom}}. You can also pick up by appointment. Payment in cash or by bank transfer when you receive the item.

returns.a: If the item doesn't fit or has a manufacturing defect, write to us and we'll sort it out with an exchange or refund. The item must be unused and in its original packaging.
